cards.card_text: Abigail says the LORD has held David back from ___ and from avenging himself with his own hand.
cards.verse_text: Now, my lord, as surely as the LORD lives and you yourself live, since the LORD has held you back from bloodshed and from avenging yourself with your own hand, may your enemies and those who seek harm for my lord be like Nabal.
cards.snippet: …live, since the LORD has held you back from bloodshed and from avenging yourself with your own hand, may your enemies and those who seek…

cards.card_text: Then David blesses her discernment, and her too, because today she kept him from bloodshed and from avenging himself by his own hand.
cards.verse_text: Blessed is your discernment, and blessed are you, because today you kept me from bloodshed and from avenging myself by my own hand.
cards.snippet: …blessed are you, because today you kept me from bloodshed and from avenging myself by my own hand.

cards.card_text: First line out of the gate: the LORD is a jealous and avenging God, full of wrath, who takes vengeance on His foes.
cards.verse_text: The LORD is a jealous and avenging God; the LORD is avenging and full of wrath.
cards.snippet: The LORD is a jealous and avenging God; the LORD is avenging and full of wrath.
